meaning: Gödel's 1970 variant as formalized in the AFP theory GoedelVariantHOML1.thy is inconsistent: Ax2a, Ax3 and Ax4 hold in no Kripke model with a world, on any frame (theorem Inconsistency). The source of the inconsistency is the 1970 essence (DEF-ESSENCE-GOEDEL-1970): the empty property is an essence of everything (GOEDEL-1970-EMPTY-PROPERTY-IS-ESSENCE), so necessary existence in the 1970 sense requires a dead-end world, and Ax4 then makes the empty property positive. Scott's essence excludes the empty property (SCOTT-EMPTY-PROPERTY-NOT-ESSENCE), and Scott's axioms are satisfiable in a model with a world (SCOTT-PREMISES-SATISFIABLE-WITH-WORLD). Ax4 is needed among the 1970 axioms: without it Ax1, Ax2a, Ax2b, Ax3 and symmetry hold in a one-world model (premisesJointlySatisfiable in GOEDEL-1970-POSSIBLE-GOD-LIKE-NECESSARILY-EXISTS). The S5 axioms of HOMLinHOL.thy, Ax1 and Ax2b are not used, and no excluded middle. Formal consequence inside the Lean embedding of the AFP theory (DEF-HOML-ACTUALIST-NECESSITY) only: it shows nothing about what Gödel intended, how his manuscript developed, nor whether the axioms are true.
